concept: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field
summary: Source-anchored research for Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: IBM Cloudability documents MongoDB resource tags as part of invoice data, without extra Cloudability permissions to enable those tags. It also synthesizes cldy:mongodb:groupid and cldy:mongodb:groupname from billing fields; those names should not be assumed to be native Atlas resource-tag keys. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

GET /api/atlas/v2/orgs/{orgId}/invoices/pending returns invoices accruing charges for the current billing cycle. Resource tags are exposed per line item at results[].lineItems[].tags for external cost-allocation reporting. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

The pending-invoice response defines tags as an object with additional properties of type array[string]. Consumers should preserve multiple string values for a key instead of assuming a scalar string or an array of key/value objects. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

MongoDB invoice documentation says API and CSV tags reflect configuration when the API is invoked or the CSV is generated. Within a billing cycle, reconfigured tags appear as the latest configuration, rather than a history of tag changes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Resource tags returned by the Atlas Admin API reflect your tag configuration at the moment the API is invoked, and if you reconfigure tags within a billing cycle the invoice reflects only the latest configuration. Retaining retrieved tags with a retrieval timestamp is a reasonable implementation practice that follows from this, but it is not a MongoDB-documented recommendation. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md

DoiT documents automatically importing MongoDB Atlas resource tags as Cloud Analytics system labels with a mongodb/ prefix; for example, environment becomes mongodb/environment. This is a downstream mapping, rather than the native pending-invoice JSON format. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21)

The MongoDB launch post, updated March 11, 2025, says tags typically appear on invoice line items within 48 hours after addition and scopes eligibility to tagged cluster-level line items. Treat that timing and scope as dated guidance, not a completeness guarantee for every charge. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-03-11)

Atlas invoice tags can categorize spending by custom business dimensions beyond project or cluster names, and the billing API can feed that line-item data into external FinOps tools. (high confidence)

The pending-invoice endpoint lists Organization Billing Viewer as its required role. Viewing linked invoices in a cross-organization setup requires Organization Billing Admin or Organization Owner access for the paying organization. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)
